name: USPTO Trademark Phrase Screener
title: USPTO Trademark Phrase Screener: Live/Dead Wordmarks, Classes
uses: Print on demand and merch sellers screening phrases before they upload designs
Flagging live marks in class 25 (clothing) and class 16 (paper goods) for a phrase list
Brand and product teams doing a first pass on name ideas before a full legal search
AI agents checking whether a phrase already has live USPTO wordmarks

inputs.name: phrases
inputs.title: Phrases
inputs.description: Phrases or design names to screen, one per line, e.g. plant mom, just one more chapter.

inputs.name: maxMarksPerPhrase
inputs.title: Max marks listed per phrase
inputs.description: How many exact and close wordmarks to list. Counts and the live class 25/16 flags still use the full hit set.

inputs.name: includeDead
inputs.title: Include dead marks in the list
inputs.description: If false, listed marks are live only. Dead counts are still reported.

description: Screen a list of phrases against the public USPTO trademark search (no login, no API key). Returns exact and close wordmarks with serial number, live/dead status, international classes, and flags for any live mark in class 25 or 16. $0.001 per phrase.

sampleOutput.source: USPTO Trademark Search (tmsearch.uspto.gov public backend, no API key)
sampleOutput.closeMatchNote: Close means the phrase appears in the wordmark, or matches with spaces removed. Not a legal confusion analysis.
